mentions.name: Solarable
mentions.description: A tool that helps UK homeowners and building managers assess whether their buildings are suitable for solar panels, combining several APIs including DEFRA DSM datasets (LiDAR captured from planes) to promote solar panel adoption.
mentions.problem: The UK has some of the most expensive energy in the world, and homeowners and building managers lack an easy way to know whether their buildings are suitable for solar panels.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've launched a new tool that tries to promote Solar panels. The UK has some of the most expensive energy in the world, so I've been trying to let homeowners and building managers understand if their building's are suitable.

Uses some APIs all plugged together - including the DEFRA datasets for DSM (LiDAR from planes).

https://solarable.org

mentions.name: Solarable
mentions.description: This site provides guidance on plug-in solar panels, which recently became legal in the UK. It uses data about a house to generate a solar rating for the property and helps work out the pitch direction of the roof.
mentions.problem: Finding the pitch direction of a roof is difficult, and plug-in solar has only recently become legal in the UK.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on trying to give some guidance on solar panels.

Plug in solar became legal here in the UK

Still sussing it out but started shipping something

Finding the pitch direction of the roof is kinda hard

Uses data from the house to try and get a rating

https://solarable.org
